as_told.title: Robertson panel sets the Blue Book mandate

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to papers from the Robertson Panel, a 1953 government panel whose report was classified at the time. He says the documents show that Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, had the explicit aim of throwing the public off and downplaying, suppressing and explaining away UFO sightings. Elsewhere, citing the physicist Hal Puthoff, he puts the reason differently: a fear that the subject would set off mass hysteria.
